counterfactual_missing_items: Granulomas are not described, excluding sarcoidosis.
Follicular plugging or epidermal inflammation is absent, excluding discoid lupus.
Mucin deposition is not described, excluding follicular mucinosis.
decisive_items: Several round atrophic lesions on his face, symmetric and bilateral, located especially on the malar and preauricular areas, with a diameter of 5 to 10 mm.
The skin lesions were not indurated and displayed no epidermal changes.
Orcein stain demonstrated reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell
response.rationale: R6 best integrates the full raw vignette: symmetric atrophic malar/preauricular lesions without epidermal changes, epidermal dell with superficial lymphocytic infiltrate and dermal fibrosis, and orcein-proven loss of elastic fibers. R3 shares the clinical distribution and lymphocytic infiltrate but lacks the elastic-fiber loss and is contradicted by the absence of epidermal changes and prior inflammation. R5 only captures the elastic-fiber finding without the clinical morphology; R2/R1/R4 are unsupported by missing granulomas/mucin and by the non-inflammatory history. C1 is a redundant anatomy completion of R6.

rejected.why: Only the orcein elastic-fiber loss is captured; the label atrophic dermatofibrosis is not supported by the non-indurated clinical lesions and lacks the composite follicular atrophoderma picture.
Sarcoidosis requires granulomas, which are absent; lymphocytic infiltrate and atrophy are nonspecific.
Follicular mucinosis requires mucin deposition, not described; scar-like lesions and lymphocytic infiltrate are insufficient.
Follicular lupus is not supported by the denied prior inflammation and lacks histopath raw evidence.
Redundant append-only completion of R6; adds anatomy already contained in R6's raw span without independent diagnostic evidence.
